note: Emmys week. Kimmel and The Daily Show went dark Monday for the ceremony, where The Late Show with Stephen Colbert won Outstanding Variety Series; the next night Colbert made his first late-night appearance since the finale, as Kimmel's guest. Meyers was still on hiatus until September 21, and no fresh quotable lines surfaced from the Daily Show's guest-host nights, so Fallon carried most of the week. No official YouTube upload matched closely enough to link with confidence.

jokes.topic: Stephen Colbert appearing as his guest the night after beating Kimmel for the Variety Series Emmy
jokes.joke: Don't tell Donald Trump. If he knows there are two of us here, he could call in an airstrike, or SEAL Team Six, or who the hell knows what.
jokes.context: Colbert's first late-night return since The Late Show's finale in May; Kimmel also joked about losing the Emmy to him, and Colbert shaved his post-show beard on air.

jokes.topic: Trump promising to keep AI "under control," after earlier bragging about acing his cognitive tests
jokes.joke: We're relying on Trump to beat AI. I don't even think Trump can beat Wordle.
jokes.context: Set up with Trump's own line: "I'd like to see ChatGPT pick out a zebra on a cognitive test. I don't think so, buddy."

jokes.topic: Trump awarding cabinet members points for campaign visits, with the winner getting dinner with him
jokes.joke: Dinner with Trump is a very unique experience. The Secret Service gives you a poncho and warns you that you're in the 'splash zone.'
jokes.context: Also: "I'm not sure watching Trump eat is the reward he thinks it is."

jokes.topic: Trump telling a North Carolina crowd that high gas prices are a small price to pay for the Iran war
jokes.joke: Last night in North Carolina, Trump said high gas prices are a very low price to pay for the war. Then his teleprompter said, 'Hold for booing.'

jokes.topic: Trump threatening to tear down the Kennedy Center after it wouldn't carry his name
jokes.joke: Usually when Trump is demolishing something on Air Force One, it's a bucket of KFC.
